brokerCapacities.doc: Used by AutoDiscoveryBrokerCapacityConfigResolver only for capacity that is neither discovered nor in the entry of a broker, e.g. the network capacity of brokers whose network interface reports no speed. Values from this entry are flagged as estimated. CPU is in cores and network in KB/s: 1220703 KB/s is 10 Gbit/s.

Overrides discovered values of broker 3: log dir /data/kafka-1 counts as 500000 MB instead of the size of its volume, and the network capacity is 5 Gbit/s. The other log dirs and the CPU cores of broker 3 are still discovered. An offline or removed log dir is never counted, even if it is listed here.
